rca of the issue: Bug 1 (launch-check email 'not configured'): launch_check() invoked mailer.configured() before load_settings() ran, so the in-memory settings object was empty at check time even though a Resend key was persisted in DB. Fix: load_settings() is now invoked prior to the mailer.configured() probe, and mailer additionally reads RESEND_FROM env as sender fallback. Bug 2 (coupon URL domain): FRONTEND_URL env now standardised to https://rrclub.online; coupon_public hint and domain label both reflect the correct host. Both bugs verified fixed via GET /api/admin/launch-check, GET /api/admin/settings, and GET /api/public/site.
